info.title: precept-dashboard
info.description: A local dashboard for Precept: watch runs as they happen, with every test as it starts and finishes and its log as it is written, and run a test, a suite or a whole project from it. Start it with `precept-dashboard`; local runs find it on their own.

options.name: --port
options.description: Listen on this port instead of a free one.

options.name: --no-browser
options.description: Do not open the page in a browser.
